summary: This Phase 2 clinical trial is studying low-dose pioglitazone in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus and a serious liver disease called nonalcoholic steatohepatitis, which means fat buildup and inflammation in the liver. The study plans to enroll 166 participants who are between 21 and 75 years old. Researchers will compare the effects of the drug against an inactive placebo treatment. The trial is currently recruiting participants and is sponsored by the University of Florida.
